description: PostgreSQL 18 tsvector parsing, canonical output, positions, weights, functions, concatenation, comparison, storage, and restart-safe equality
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_tsvector (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, document TSVECTOR NOT NULL UNIQUE);
SELECT document, length(document), strip(document) FROM type_matrix_tsvector WHERE id = 'canonical';
SELECT id, document FROM type_matrix_tsvector WHERE id <> 'canonical' ORDER BY document;
SELECT '''a'':1'::tsvector < '''a'':2'::tsvector AS position_order, '''a'':1'::tsvector = '''a'':2'::tsvector AS position_equal, '''a'':1'::tsvector < '''b'':1'::tsvector AS lexeme_order;
SELECT ''::tsvector AS empty_vector, length(''::tsvector), '''a'':16384'::tsvector AS clamped_position;
